sources.snippet: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, packed for the SiLVANN engine (the Eval-Apply GPU Interpreter and its neural network library): every layer matrix at 4 bits a weight (TurboQuant, a per-row scale), each rotated along its input axis with a blocked Hadamard-and-signs rotation; the embedding and head at 8 bits; norms and other small tensors kept lossless. D4: dense 4 (the model has no experts). About 15 GB.
